content:
linh.nguyen: Heads-up — opening a short ‘soft window’ for the v3.8 roll. 30m maintenance window starting now. Need a quick readiness sweep and explicit pin/unpin plan. @sasha @jordan pls confirm owners and rollback triggers.
sasha: On it. I ran the smoke checklist vs staging earlier. Key items: migrations are non-blocking, config flag `enable_v3_8` is feature-flagged, caches can be flushed remotely.
jordan: Confirmed owner for rollout and rollback. Will pin model-serving to `v3.8-rc4` for the change window. If errors >5% 5xx or latency >2x baseline for 3 consecutive minutes, we rollback.
megan: Release notes: https://redwood.internal/release-notes/3.8 — includes changelog, DB migration notes, and rollback instructions. Also added a note about ephemeral quota bump for Dedicated during warmup.
oncall: Adding rollback triggers: error rate spike, cache miss storms, or KMS auth errors. If any of those happen we trigger `rollback-to v3.7` and notify #incidents.
devops: Rollback playbook snippet (for quick copy):
```
# rollback shorthand
kubectl -n inference set image svc/model-serving model=model:v3.7 && 
kubectl rollout status deploy/model-serving -w --timeout=3m
# invalidate caches
curl -X POST https://ops-api/internal/cache/invalidate -d '{"service":"model-serving"}'
```
Please run from release-runner.
deploy-bot: Preflight checks: unit tests ✅, e2e smoke ✅, infra quotas ✅, canary tasks warmed ✅. Estimated rollout time ~7m.
sasha: Quick checklist status: DB migrations — no locks; config toggles — present; alerting runbook attached in the notes. I'll monitor metrics and take the lead on hotfix unpin if needed.
linh.nguyen: @deploy-bot please pin `model-serving` to `v3.8-rc4` now. We will unpin after 15m post-warmup if stable. Anyone object? :thumbsup: / :question:
jordan: done — pin applied, commit 9f3b2ea. I pushed a short pin note to deploy-log.
deploy-bot: Pin action recorded: model-serving -> v3.8-rc4 by jordan at 1682547921. Canary traffic set to 10% -> ramping to 50% over 4m.
megan: I've posted a tiny ‘launch brief’ in the release notes (section: operational checklist) — includes who to call for emergency rollback: @jordan, @sasha, @oncall.
linh.nguyen: Observability dashboards: https://grafana.internal/d/launch-v3-8. I'll be watching latency and error heatmap. Sasha, call out if you see the cache miss counter >2k/min.
sasha: Seeing small CPU bump on canary hosts, expected. No error spike so far.
deploy-bot: Canary ramp to 50% complete. No anomalies detected in 6m.
linh.nguyen: Okay, proceeding to ramp to full traffic over the next 5m. Reminder: if any rollback trigger, call the playbook and notify #incidents.
release-bot: Deployment event: model-serving rolled to v3.8-rc4 across 100% traffic at 1682547980. All health checks passing.
oncall: I'm keeping the runbook open and tailing logs. If anything weird, I'll execute rollback and post reason + timestamps.
megan: Quick post-deploy notes: tag release `v3.8` in repo, follow up with external changelog tomorrow. For now, team — great job.
linh.nguyen: Thanks all. Leaving soft window open for 15 more minutes to watch for slow regressions, then we'll unpin. :rocket:
jordan: Will unpin at 1682548870 unless objections.
sasha: 👍 monitoring continues.
